offering_description.value: Boku processes local payments for global merchants, primarily digital goods and subscription businesses. It connects merchant checkouts to mobile carriers, digital wallets and local bank payment networks through a single integration.

primary_services.value: direct carrier billing; digital wallet payment processing; account-to-account payment processing; recurring payment processing; merchant settlement

customer_segment.value: B2B: digital marketplaces, streaming and gaming companies, and other online merchants

end_markets.value: digital commerce; streaming media; video games; app marketplaces

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: processing one-time and recurring payments through local payment methods

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: routes and settles consumer payments through carriers, wallets and bank networks for online merchants; software / platform: combines local payment integrations into one checkout connection for merchants

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: carrier billing, digital wallet payments and account-to-account payments

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise merchant relationships and direct checkout integrations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: payment processing and settlement subject to licensing and oversight by the UK FCA and other local regulators
